sourceSummary: Swindon Town current 2026/27 identity selection cross-checked against the committed FootballSquads roster/DOB source, current match/loan evidence and detailed current or last-published Transfermarkt role/value records. Snapshot-date birthdays are normalized, broad identity groups are refined to SWOS roles, and unavailable published values are encoded as 0 rather than estimated.

Mitchell Clark.notes: Transfermarkt publishes this player as Mitch Clark; the footballName key remains matched to the committed identity feed.

Stephan Negru.notes: Age is normalized at the 2026-09-27 snapshot from the published 24/07/2002 date of birth; older cached pages still display 23.

Sam Inwood.notes: Current 2026/27 match evidence confirms Swindon membership on loan from Bolton. Age is normalized from the published 17/09/2005 date of birth. No published market value is available; 0 records unavailable evidence rather than an estimate.

James Debayo.notes: Transfermarkt confirms the 2026/27 Swindon loan from Hull. Age is normalized from the published 11/07/2005 date of birth. No published market value is shown in the cited current evidence; 0 records unavailable evidence rather than an estimate.

Ollie Clarke.notes: Age is normalized at the 2026-09-27 snapshot from the published 29/06/1992 date of birth; older cached pages still display 33.

Joseph Hungbo.notes: Current Swindon match evidence confirms 2026/27 membership. The detailed Transfermarkt profile is stale on club membership but supplies the right-wing role and last published €375k value.

Joe Snowdon.notes: Detailed role evidence lists right midfield, mapped to the SWOS right-sided midfield/wing role.

Tom Nichols.notes: Age is normalized at the 2026-09-27 snapshot from the published 28/08/1993 date of birth; older cached pages still display 32. Detailed current role is attacking midfield, with centre-forward and left-wing alternatives.

Paul Glatzel.notes: Detailed current role is attacking midfield, with centre-forward and right-wing alternatives.
